title: Fufu with Peanut Sauce
description: Fufu with Peanut Sauce is a Togo classic prepared with yam, plantain, yellow onion, tomato. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 30 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 14 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 25 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
